headline: Why did Keffe D feel so comfortable confessing to his role in the murder of Tupac Shakur?
body: Why did Keffe D feel so comfortable confessing to his role in the murder of Tupac Shakur? ⁣ ⁣ This week, after someone was finally convicted of killing the rap icon, fans were quick to call Keffe D an idiot for admitting to crimes on camera and in his book. ⁣ ⁣ But there may have been a very good reason why he assumed he'd never get convicted and why even local police thought the crime would never get solved. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
